reason: ProMentor is primarily an AI-assisted programming education skill that turns an existing project into a structured, hands-on course with guided implementation, testing, review, progress tracking, and a dashboard.

summaries.zh: ProMentor 将现有项目转化为分章节的动手编程课程，并提供源码学习、实现指导、行为测试、提示、代码评审和进度面板。
summaries.en: ProMentor turns an existing project into a structured hands-on programming course with source guidance, implementation support, behavioral testing, code review, and progress tracking.

capabilities: Analyzes project architecture and source code
Generates structured learning chapters and labs
Runs behavioral tests and reports results
Provides contextual hints and code review
Stores course progress and submission history
